description.value:
An Arasaka targeting system mounted on a Tsunami weapon? This formidable combination is starting to make waves.

Category: Super Luxury • Fabrication: DV29 - 10,000eb - 1 Month

Class: Iconic EQ Sniper Rifle • Skill: Shoulder Arms • Range: Sniper Rifle

Damage: 6d6 • Capacity: 1 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: No

Slots: 0 • Attachments: Match Trigger, Precision Stock, Smart Rebuild (w/ Advanced Smartlink), Sniper Rifle Rechamber, Sniping Scope • Mods: None

Special Features: Incompatible with Capacity modifying Attachments. Can only load Improved Smart Ammunition. While connected to this weapon’s Smart Rebuild, the user gains a +2 Complementary Bonus to Aimed Shots made with this weapon. When using this weapon to make a Head Aimed Shot and rolling for damage, 5s count as 6s for the purposes of incurring Critical Injuries.

Targets attempting to dodge Aimed Shots and Held Action Attacks (of any kind) from this weapon suffer a -1 penalty to their Check to do so [Match Trigger]. Drawing this weapon requires an Action, even while it is easily accessible, and while the user is Prone or the weapon is Mounted on a Bipod, if they fire the weapon in Single Shot and roll a 2 on their Attack Check, they gain a +1 bonus to their Check, or a +2 if they instead rolled a 1 [Precision Stock]. When firing this weapon, if the user rolls a Critical Failure (1) during their Attack Check, they do not roll an implosion d10 [Advanced Smartlink].

Fabrication: DV29 - 10,000eb - 1 Month
Range: Sniper Rifle
Pre-installed: Match Trigger, Precision Stock, Smart Rebuild (w/ Advanced Smartlink), Sniper Rifle Rechamber, Sniping Scope (effects already included in these stats)

Foundry notes:

  • Iconic weapons follow the Exotic weapon rules: no Non-Basic Ammunition and no Attachment Slots unless this entry says otherwise.
  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the Super Luxury benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Weapons).
